# Study Feed Sample

A three-part sample that checks the show feed end to end.

## Offer and acceptance

A contract needs an **offer**, an *acceptance* that mirrors it, and consideration.
See [the Restatement](https://example.com/restatement) for the rule.

## Consideration

- A bargained-for exchange.
- Past consideration is no consideration.

## Remedies

Expectation damages put the injured party where performance would have.
